summary.headline: Prosperity After Labor
summary.text: Discussion of cadent or impeded significators, showing how applying to angular planets, domiciles, or exaltations can bring prosperity after labor. A nocturnal nativity with Gemini rising illustrates poverty through the Moon’s triplicity lords, Mars and Venus, both cadent from the angles.
